test_overview: Evaluated the MVP Pilot regression test plan against the flight logbook app (React frontend + FastAPI at localhost:8000). App's UTC "today" D0=2026-08-08 (from flight form default date); D_minus_10=2026-07-29, D_minus_5=2026-08-03. All 5 steps passed fully, including all non-fatal sub-checks: (1) Pilot registration succeeded and routed to Pilot Logbook experience; aircraft N-REGRESS 1 created as unlinked (Maintenance column '—', no Owner identity). (2) Three flights logged with Hobbs Time, MVP validation enforced, all listed most-recent-first. (3) Currency computed over last-90-days window: Day Not Current (2/3 LDG), Night Not Current. (4) Editing Flight 1 Day Landings 0->1 immediately flipped Day Currency to Current (3/3, 3/3) while Night remained Not Current. (5) CSV export contained header + 3 rows, Hobbs values 100.0/101.0/102.0 matched to correct flights, and no Owner maintenance/inspection data. Final score 35/35.

steps.description: test_pilot_registration_and_aircraft_creation: Registered 'Regression Pilot' (pilot.regression@example.com, PilotPass123!, role Pilot) via /register; auto-logged in and routed to /logbook (Pilot Flights experience, not Owner Dashboard). Created aircraft N-REGRESS 1 / Cessna 172S / Airplane SEL successfully; no Owner linking prompt needed/appeared; aircraft selectable in the flight form. Non-fatal check passed: aircraft list shows Status 'Active', Maintenance column '—', no Owner name/maintenance badges or inspection statuses.

test_flight_logging_with_hobbs_time: Added Flight 1 (D0=2026-08-08, KSFO->KLAX, Total 2.0/Day 1.5/Night 0.5, PIC 2.0, DayTO 1/DayLDG 0/NightTO 0/NightLDG 1, Hobbs 100.0), Flight 2 (2026-07-29, KSFO->KOAK, 1.0/1.0/0.0, PIC 1.0, 1/1/0/0, Hobbs 101.0), Flight 3 (2026-08-03, KOAK->KSFO, 1.0/0.5/0.5, PIC 1.0, 1/1/1/1, Hobbs 102.0). All saved successfully (MVP validation passed: Day+Night=Total, PIC<=Total) and appear in the Flights list most-recent-first. Non-fatal check passed: Hobbs Time stored and viewable per row (100.0/101.0/102.0).

test_currency_calculation: Analytics page preset 'Last 90 Days' selected; Day/Night Currency window '2026-05-11 to 2026-08-08' (standard last-90-days ending at D0). Airplane-SEL card: Day Not Current 'TO: 3/3 | Ldg: 2/3' (3 TO >=3, 2 LDG <3); Night Not Current 'TO: 1/3 | Ldg: 2/3' (1 TO <3). Non-fatal check passed: counts match expected totals; Overall Totals also confirm Day TO/Ldg 3/2, Night TO/Ldg 1/2, Flights 3.

test_edit_flight_updates_currency: Edited Flight 1 (2026-08-08, KSFO->KLAX) via modal: Day Landings 0 -> 1, clicked Update. Row updated to Ldg 1/1. Returned to Analytics/Currency: Day Currency immediately Current (TO 3/3 | Ldg 3/3) without needing the permitted manual refresh; Night still Not Current (TO 1/3 | Ldg 2/3).

test_export_includes_hobbs_no_maintenance: Clicked Export CSV -> file downloaded. CSV contains header + exactly 3 flight data rows with flight fields and aircraft attributes. Hobbs Time column present; per-flight values verified by unique date/route: 2026-08-08 KSFO->KLAX=100.0, 2026-07-29 KSFO->KOAK=101.0, 2026-08-03 KOAK->KSFO=102.0 (one-decimal). No Owner inspection/maintenance details exported (no Annual/Transponder/ELT/100-Hour/custom due dates, hobbs due thresholds, or OK/Due Soon/Overdue/Unairworthy statuses).
